dashboard.label: SSL / TLS Security Audit
dashboard.description: Audit weak ciphers, deprecated TLS protocols, and certificate drift.

search.query: `ssl_cert_index` sourcetype="cert:ssl:json" | stats latest(ssl_version) as ssl_version, latest(ssl_cipher) as ssl_cipher, latest(ssl_issuer) as ssl_issuer, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | search ssl_version IN ("TLSv1", "TLSv1.1", "SSLv2", "SSLv3") OR ssl_cipher="*RC4*" OR ssl_cipher="*3DES*" OR ssl_cipher="*NULL*" | eval Target=dest . ":" . dest_port, last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") | table Target, sni, ssl_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_issuer, last_seen | rename Target as "Endpoint", sni as "SNI", ssl_version as "Protocol", ssl_cipher as "Negotiated Cipher", ssl_issuer as "Issuer", last_seen as "Audit Timestamp"
